subject: Auriga RFI: SIG questionnaire — control owners & sample packet
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auriga.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@auriga.io>
Date: 2026-05-14 09:12 -0700
Subject: RFI: SIG questionnaire and control evidence packet

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking Auriga's RFI — we're working through the SIG questionnaire and need a couple of things from Redwood to keep procurement moving: a mapping of your controls to the SIG rows, the named internal control owners for each control we’ll review, and a small sample packet (redacted) showing the types of artifacts you can deliver for a SOC 2 proof (logs, config screenshots, policy snippets).

Can you: 1) confirm who on your side will own control responses, 2) give an estimated date for a sample packet, and 3) let us know if you can include telemetry/ingest examples for retention KMS and access logs?

Procurement is targeting a final security pass by 2026-06-01, so any help to accelerate is appreciated. I attached the Auriga SIG worksheet (v1) for context.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Vendor Security — Auriga Technologies
liam.oconnor@auriga.io

[Attachment: Auriga_SIG_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auriga.io>
Date: 2026-05-15 10:05 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: SIG questionnaire and control evidence packet

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask and the worksheet.

Quick answers up front:
- Control owners: I'll coordinate internal owners across Security and Product; initial point people will be Karthik Iyer (security controls & telemetry) and Mina Haddad (access controls, custodian proofs).
- Sample packet ETA: we can prepare a redacted packet by 2026-05-20 for your review.
- Telemetry examples: yes — we'll include a small tokenized telemetry extract and a sample retention KMS proof (redacted), plus a short README.

I'll kick off the internal runbook and attach a short ownership template to speed mapping. Can we schedule a 30-minute control-walkthrough on Tue 2026-05-18? Slots I have: 10:00–10:30 PDT or 15:00–15:30 PDT.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

[Attachment: SIG_ownership_template.xlsx]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auriga.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-16 08:42 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: SIG questionnaire and control evidence packet

Liam / Jonas — looping in a couple of clarifying items from the runtime/telemetry side so we can scope the sample correctly.

1) For retention proofs: do you need full-token logs (we will tokenise) or aggregated retention reports? We typically provide a time-series extract + redaction map.
2) For KV cache/keyproof: do you need KMS usage logs for a single-day snapshot or a rolling 30-day sample?
3) Are there any particular SIG rows you want prioritized (e.g., access control, key management, change control)? If you mark row IDs in the worksheet we will prioritize those in the packet.

Jonas — I started mapping rows 1–50 to our control IDs in the template and left notes where we will need customer confirmation. I also included a tiny redwood-sample-telemetry-log.txt as an example of the format (all entries tokenized).

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Security PM, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@auriga.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-17 14:20 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: SIG questionnaire and control evidence packet

Hi Jonas & Karthik — thanks, this is great and aligns with our timeline.

A few clarifications from procurement and InfoSec:
- We prefer a rolling 7-day telemetry sample with tokenized identifiers rather than a single-day snapshot.
- For KMS usage, a 30-day rolling sample is ideal (audit entries only).
- Priority SIG rows: please focus on Access Control (AC), Key Management (KM), and Change Management (CM) rows — I added AC/KM/CM highlights in the worksheet and re-uploaded v2.

We can do the walkthrough on Tue 2026-05-18 at 10:00 PDT. Procurement would like the sample packet delivered by 2026-05-20 so legal can begin redaction review.

Regards,
Priya Desai
Vendor Risk Manager — Auriga Technologies
priya.desai@auriga.io

[Attachment: Auriga_SIG_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auriga.io>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@auriga.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-18 17:05 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: SIG questionnaire and control evidence packet — next steps

Thanks, all — confirmed for Tue 2026-05-18 10:00 PDT. Agenda for the 30-minute walkthrough:
1) Review prioritized SIG rows (AC, KM, CM) and control-owner assignments.
2) Walk through the redacted sample packet contents and README.
3) Agree on delivery window and any redaction rules for legal.

Deliverables and dates:
- Redacted sample packet (includes tokenized telemetry 7-day rolling extract, 30-day KMS audit snapshot, policy excerpts): delivery by 2026-05-20 EOD.
- Completed control-owner mapping (first pass): 2026-05-19.
- Follow-up Q&A and legal redaction support: ongoing through procurement close.

I've uploaded a shared folder with the ownership template and will drop the packet there once ready: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bExampleSharedDrive. Also adding the HubSpot deal for tracking (DEAL-7890). If you need an NDA or extra legal paperwork in advance, we can send a DocuSign request — flag if required.

See you Tuesday.

— Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
